# Tasbeeh Go — Full Content

> Free, offline-first digital tasbeeh & dhikr counter for phone and desktop.

Canonical site: https://tasbeehgo.vercel.app/
Languages: English, Arabic
License/Price: Free, no ads, no account required.

## What is Tasbeeh Go?

Tasbeeh Go is a digital misbaha (electronic tasbeeh) that replaces a physical
bead counter. It functions as a dhikr counter, zikr counter, and dua counter,
letting you count adhkar with adjustable targets, laps, and haptic feedback. It
is a progressive web app (PWA): it installs to the home screen on iOS and
Android, works fully offline, requires no account, shows no ads, and stores all
counts privately on the user's own device.

## Features

- Digital tasbeeh and dhikr counter with custom targets, laps, and auto-advance.
- Multi-step routines: chain several adhkar together and advance automatically as
  each target is reached, with an optional looping mode for single dhikr.
- Curated library of authentic morning and evening adhkar and du'as, including
  tasbeeh after salah and du'as for protection.
- Create, save, and pin your own custom dhikr and routines.
- The 99 Names of Allah (Asma ul Husna) with Arabic script, transliteration, and
  English meaning, each countable with the built-in tasbeeh.
- Statistics: daily goals, current and longest streaks, a 12-week activity
  heatmap, and milestone tracking.
- Selectable Arabic typefaces: Naskh (Amiri, Scheherazade, Noto Naskh, Lateef),
  Indo-Pak Nastaliq (Gulzar), and Kufi (Reem Kufi).
- Customizable bead themes and light/dark/system appearance.
- Daily reminder notifications for morning, evening, and bedtime adhkar.
- Backup and restore all data via a JSON export/import file.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Tasbeeh Go?
Tasbeeh Go is a free digital tasbeeh (dhikr) counter for phone and desktop. It
replaces a physical misbaha, letting you count adhkar, build custom dua routines,
and track your daily progress.

### Is Tasbeeh Go free to use?
Yes. Tasbeeh Go is completely free, with no ads and no account required. Your
counts are stored privately on your own device.

### Does the tasbeeh counter work offline?
Yes. Tasbeeh Go is an offline-first progressive web app (PWA). You can install it
to your home screen and count dhikr without an internet connection.

### Does it include the 99 Names of Allah?
Yes. Tasbeeh Go includes the 99 Names of Allah (Asma ul Husna) with
transliteration and meaning, alongside a large library of common adhkar and du'as.

### Which Arabic fonts are supported?
Arabic text can be shown in several typefaces: Amiri, Scheherazade, and Noto
Naskh (Naskh styles), Lateef, Gulzar (Indo-Pak Nastaliq), and Reem Kufi (Kufi).

### How is my data stored?
All data — counts, custom dhikr, streaks, and settings — is stored locally in your
browser on your own device. Nothing is uploaded to a server, and you can export a
backup file at any time.
